title: MorphoEval: A Pilot Case Study in Auditing Morphology Reproductions and Publishing Criterion-Referenced Scores as Nanopublications
description:
This deposition bundles the MorphoEval Reproducibility Report — a preprint presenting a pilot case study in auditing the morphology reproductions in the morpholib repository — together with the complete source code of the repository at the corresponding revision. Two files are included: the report PDF and a full archive of the source.

MorphoEval is a seven-dimension, weighted rubric (model fidelity, specimen match, parameter expressivity, morphometric validation, source traceability, code traceability, reproducibility package) applied to Python reproductions of published models and datasets of biological form: Thompson's coordinate transformations (1917) tested across 791 species, Gray–Scott/Turing patterns, Raup's shell-coiling morphospace, Bressloff et al.'s V1 form constants, Chindapol's flow-driven coral growth, the Planform and Limbform graph-encoded morphologies (Lobo & Levin), the WormGUIDES C. elegans embryo atlas, the Hoffmann–Donoughe insect wing-venation model, Cervera, Levin & Mafe's bioelectric planarian synthesis, Zhang, Goldstein & Levin's autonomous sorting morphogenesis, and Odonata wing cells in fossils. To separate implementation fidelity from biological validity, faithfulness is decomposed and reported along two axes — model-implementation fidelity (weight 30) and biological/empirical validation (weight 40) — alongside reproducibility (weight 30). Scores on [0, 100] are explicitly defined as uncalibrated criterion-referenced ratings rather than probabilities of faithfulness (their score / 100 values in pk:hasProbability and pk:weightOfEvidence are unit-interval rescalings for ProbKnow template conformance). Every score is backed by line-pinned evidence at a recorded commit and by morphometric measurements on the rendered outputs, and every audit is emitted as ProbKnow-template-conformant nanopublications, cryptographically signed, and verified.

MorphoEval is the simulation-faithfulness sibling of BioEval (10.5281/zenodo.20567719) and NeuroEval (10.5281/zenodo.20622878). Across 12 audit files (25 script-level passes), 9 primary audits come from the builder model (claude-fable-5-1, Anthropic), 2 independent passes on Cervera–Levin–Mafe come from gpt-5.6-sol (OpenAI), and a complete 10-script second-assessor pass by gemini-4-argon (Google) dual-scores every active evaluated script across two companies' models (Spearman ρ = 0.891, Kendall τ = 0.778, Pearson r = 0.920 on padded scores; ρ = 0.903 on applicable-only scores; exact ρ = 1.00 on the initial 5-script blinded subset; dimension-level ρ = 0.796, r = 0.813 across all 70 pairs, MAD = 10.4 points).
